item.title: 4-hour battery storage is cheaper to install than gas turbines all across globe
item.description:
📝 Latin America Solar PV with single-axis tracking remains the lowest-cost generation technology in Latin America in 2026, with average costs expected to fall 38% by 2060. China leads the world on grid-scale storage costs, with a benchmark LCOE more than 55% below the rest of Asia Pacific average of $134/MWh. Europe carries the highest fossil-fuel generation costs of any modeled region, with levelized carbon costs projected to surpass fuel costs by 2030.
🔗 Read more: https://www.solarpowerworldonline.com/2026/10/4-hour-battery-storage-is-cheaper-to-install-than-gas-turbines-all-across-globe/

item.title: The Deeply Impersonal Personalized Recruiter Mail
item.description:
📝 It goes something like this: Your work on infrastructure at Railway, along with your earlier years building observability software at City Storage Systems and storage systems on AWS Glacier, is exactly the kind of platform background this role calls for. So it’s unsurprising to me that it’s for a Django fullstack role when my history shows I’m an infra engineer with no professional Python experience. All of that coupled with even the job description being full of extremely common LLMisms pushes these emails below the plain old templated emails in my mind.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.pentlander.com/the-deeply-impersonal-personalized-recruiter-mail/
